question: Shobana Chandrakumar, a recipient of Padma Shri, is a dancer of which of the following India classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is** Bharatanatyam****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shobana Chandrakumar Pillai** is an Indian actress and** Bharatanatyam dancer. Shobana danced Abhinaya, **a pivotal element in Bharata Natyam.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a major form of Indian classical dance that **originated in Tamil Nadu. **Savitha Sastry is an Indian dancer and choreographer best known as an exponent of Bharatanatyam.
 
• **Bharatanatyam traces** its origins back to the** Natyashastra**, an ancient treatise on theatre written by the** mythic priest Bharata.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Elam Endira Devi,** is an Indian classical dancer and teacher, known for her expertise and scholarship in the classical** dance form of Manipuri. **The Manipuri Dance originating from the state of Manipur.
 
• The world famous Kathak dancer, **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is the face of the Kalka-Bindadin gharana of Lucknow. Kathak is the classical dance form of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Sonal Mansingh, dancer of odissi, **a classical Indian dance for that originated in Orissa, and other Indian classical forms. Odissi is a major ancient Indian classical dance.
